title: Cloud & web app attack chains (authorized)
description: Cloud IAM/metadata/storage and web/API vuln chains, evidence-backed.
detail: **Cloud (authorized):** inventory identities/roles/storage/functions; check public/exposed storage, overly-permissive IAM, key/secret exposure, SSRF→metadata reachability (IMDSv2 token where applicable) — confirm impact minimally, don’t harvest prod secrets unless authorized. Map to cloud-attack/cloud-storage-data/ssrf-metadata skills. **Web/API:** recon→map endpoints/auth/params (httpx, js/crawl, swagger/graphql)→test authn/authz/IDOR, injection, SSRF, file upload, desync, logic (scoped, non-destructive)→evidence→finding. Prefer structured output and bind traffic. Use web-exploitation, api-security, auth-testing, graphql-api skills.
